sizeScope: No 8–32px restriction; native pixel design evidence and remaining uncertainty recorded

emptyLineOmission.rule: Entirely blank sample lines do not contribute canvas width or height; partial missing-character advances and native bearings remain unchanged.

curation.scope: 代表性字样，不以数量或细微版本差异充数；同源及疑似取模不自动等于已证实矢量转换。
